title: discovery.py: RREP hop_count overflow causes crash
description: Line 178: `install_hops = rrep.hop_count + 1` can exceed 255 when rrep.hop_count=255 (max uint8 on wire). RouteEntry(hop_count=256) raises ValueError since __post_init__ validates hop_count <= 255. RREP.from_bytes() does not validate hop_count range. Attacker can DoS the router with a crafted RREP.
close_reason: Fixed: Added hop_count/hop_limit validation to RREP.from_bytes() and RREQ.from_bytes() in messages.py. Attacker-crafted messages with values > MAX_HOP_LIMIT (15) now raise LoadngError at parse time, preventing the overflow crash in process_rrep() where install_hops = hop_count + 1. Added two new tests to verify the validation.
